result.topic_en: Scattered calculations: the Gaussian integral, an integral of an exponential in complex polar form with a sketch of lines through the origin, the line through two points, an integral form of the first-order wave equation, a Duhamel-type integral, and a sum over differences of exponentials.

$\frac{\partial v}{\partial x} = $ [?]
$f(t)\,\mathrm{d}\big(\chi(x, t-\tau) - \chi(x, t-\tau')\big)$
$\tau' = \tau + \partial\tau$
$\int_0^t f(t)\,(\chi(x, t-\tau))\partial\tau$
$u = \int_0^t f(t)\,\chi(x, t-\tau)\,\partial\tau$
$e^{-\varrho\alpha x}$
